reviews.text:
Unsweet Berry is the best color ever. I love the deep blackberry shade. There are some similarities to Dinto's Umbra shade. 

Laka's formula is slightly thicker that Dinto. Unsweet Berry is cooler and more blue-based. 

It's a comfortable formula that stains for a long time. You can also build it up to a deep shade. The stain is also very even.
reviews.zh: Unsweet Berry 係我見過最靚嘅色號。我好鍾意呢個深黑莓色。同 Dinto 嘅 Umbra 色號有少少相似。Laka 嘅質地比 Dinto 稍為厚身。Unsweet Berry 偏冷調，藍調較重。質地舒服，染色持久。可以疊加搽到更深色。染出嚟嘅效果都好均勻。

reviews.text: Colour is nothing like the picture on website. Doesnt last very long as well
reviews.zh: 顏色同網站上嘅圖片完全唔似。持久度都好差。

reviews.text:
【パケもカラーも可愛すぎる】
ラカのティントは発色とツヤ感が綺麗と評判なので初めて購入しました。120番のカフェインローズは大人っぽくて深みのあるお洒落なカラー。実際に唇に塗るのがとても楽しみです！
reviews.zh: 【包裝同顏色都太可愛】一直聽人講 Laka 嘅唇釉顯色同光澤感都幾靚，所以第一次買嚟試。120 號嘅 Caffeine Rose 係一款成熟感、帶有深度嘅時尚顏色。非常期待實際搽上嘴！

reviews.text: Really love this tint! The color is fresh and flattering, giving a juicy, natural glow to the lips. It feels lightweight and comfortable, not sticky at all, and applies smoothly for an even finish. It lasts nicely and fades in a pretty way throughout the day. The serum balm is a great bonus for extra hydration—definitely a staple in my daily makeup!
reviews.zh: 真係好鍾意呢支唇釉！顏色清新又顯白，畀嘴唇一個 juicy 嘅自然光澤。質感輕盈舒服，完全唔黏笠，順滑易搽，妝感均勻。持久度唔錯，仲會隨住一日慢慢褪成好靚嘅色調。支護唇精華係額外保濕嘅 bonus——絕對係我日常化妝嘅必備！

reviews.text: This tint adds a fresh, glossy look to the lips with a natural shine. It feels lightweight and comfortable for daily wear.
reviews.zh: 呢支唇釉畀嘴唇一個清新、有光澤、帶自然光嘅妝感。質感輕盈舒服，適合作日常使用。

reviews.text: Swatch is on the right. The shade is cool leaning neutral in person. The stain is more pink than it comes across in the picture. It’s a nice MLBB color. Can apply a little patchy sometimes, the tint lasts a few hours on the lips.
reviews.zh: 試色喺右邊。實際顏色偏冷、偏中性。染出嚟嘅顏色比相入面更加粉紅。係一個唔錯嘅 MLBB 色。有時會搽到有少少斑駁，唇釉喺嘴唇上可以維持幾個鐘。

reviews.text: 123 unsweet berry is a beautiful color for those with deeper skin and cool undertones, very vampy.
reviews.zh: 123 unsweet berry 對深膚色同冷調底調嘅人嚟講係一個好靚嘅顏色，非常有型。

reviews.text: wish it was more cool toned but still love the finish. layered with pinkier products in the photo with lop balm underneath
reviews.zh: 希望可以更加冷調，但係依然好鍾意個妝效。相入面係同偏粉紅嘅產品疊加，底層有搽潤唇膏。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
